sources.name: King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex — Madinah Mushaf (Hafs), digital edition 1441
sources.notice: Mushaf pages: the digital Madinah Mushaf (riwayat Hafs ʿan ʿĀṣim, 1441 edition) of the King Fahd Glorious Quran Printing Complex, dm.qurancomplex.gov.sa, rendered from the Complex's vector files without the page frame, running header, page number and hizb medallions (the app shows the page, juz and hizb itself), every letter, mark, verse marker and recitation note kept in place and drawn in the reading theme's ink, and used under the usage rights it publishes (dm.qurancomplex.gov.sa/rights). Comes with the app. The app is not published or endorsed by the Complex.
